% Pattern: head/label/article. A bold label in an \item or at the start of a
% paragraph that a later "Proof of A1" names is a claim, numbered with the
% label, and the proof proves it. A proof head of a part inside a proof
% environment is an item too.
% from 1407.0548
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1
% want proof-1 proof - proves=lemma-1
% want head-1 statement/claim A1
% want head-2 statement/claim A2
% want head-3 proof - proves=head-1
% want head-4 proof - proves=head-2
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{lemma}{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\begin{lemma} Each tree is a graph. \end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
We show two assertions.
\begin{enumerate}
\item[{\bf A1.}\,] Each node has a degree.
\item[{\bf A2.}\,] Each edge has two ends.
\end{enumerate}

{\it Proof of \,{\bf A1}}.\, Count the edges at the node.

{\it Proof of \,{\bf A2}}.\, An edge joins two nodes.

Then the lemma follows from {\bf A1} and {\bf A2}.
\end{proof}
\end{document}
